messages:
anya: Heads-up — noticed a batch of accounts got their healthscore reset after last night's admin-ux deploy. seeing a ~15% drop in 'onboarded' segment in the dashboard :thinking_face:

jordan: ugh. saw that too. replicated in staging — field rename from `first_touch` -> `first_contact` broke the ingestion mapping.

sam (cs_ops): is this just UI-only or did backend mapping change land?

jordan: backend mapping unchanged, but the admin export job (used by playbook runner) now emits `first_contact` when customers update contact info via new form. playbook matcher expects `first_touch`. playbook rules treat missing first_touch as not-onboarded.

anya: ok — short-term mitigation: can we make the playbook matcher accept both fields? quick fallback?

sam (cs_ops): I can patch the matcher to fallback to `first_contact` if `first_touch` missing. will deploy a hotfix to staging now and to prod after smoke.

kai (analytics): we should also run a one-off recalculation for accounts updated in the last 48h — otherwise healthscore will stay wrong. I can generate the account list.

ops-bot: deploy started by sam (cs_ops) — build #827 :construction:

jordan: thanks. once hotfix is live we should run a dry-run recalculation and surface a diff to CS owners before we overwrite any persisted scores. want to capture feedback.

sam (cs_ops): agreed. plan:
- 10m hotfix to matcher (accept both keys)
- run recalculation in dry-run mode -> produce CSV diff of account_id, old_score, new_score
- post CSV to #customer-success and tag owners for review
- if owners ack within 24h, apply changes

anya: add an automated playbook gate so future schema renames trigger an alert instead of silent drift. maybe a schema compatibility check in the export job?

kai (analytics): draft rule: export job emits a compatibility header with fields list. playbook runner verifies header against rule manifest. mismatch -> alert to #customer-success with sample payload.

sam (cs_ops): I'll add a temporary guard in the playbook runner and a follow-up ticket to add header verification in export job.

jordan: capturing quick SQL for remediation (dry-run mode first):
```sql
-- list accounts touched by export in last 48h
SELECT account_id, owner_id, healthscore FROM accounts WHERE updated_at > now() - interval '48 hours' AND (first_touch IS NULL OR first_contact IS NOT NULL);
```

kai (analytics): I'll run that and attach CSV. expecting ~1.2k rows.

anya: tagging owners will be manual for now — we don't have reliable owner mapping in some legacy rows. sam can we ensure the CSV includes `owner_id` + link to admin panel?

sam (cs_ops): yep. CSV will be `account_id, owner_id, owner_email, old_score, new_score, admin_link`. will post in thread.

ops-bot: deploy success for matcher hotfix by sam (cs_ops) — build #827 :white_check_mark:

sam (cs_ops): hotfix is live. running dry-run recalculation now. ETA ~12m.

jordan: cool. after dry-run let's do a small canary apply for accounts belonging to CS pilot group (owner in [u123,u456]). reduces risk.

kai (analytics): dry-run complete. attaching CSV to the thread (uploader). total 1,162 rows. median score delta +0.0, mean delta +3.4. ~95 accounts have delta >= 10 points.

anya: can we surface the top 95 accounts first to owners? forward to owners and ask for :eyes: ack. include a short description: cause = field rename broke matcher; proposed fix = apply recalculation; rollback = previous scores archived.

sam (cs_ops): posting CSV and pinging owners in a follow-up message. will also create a short survey link to capture owner feedback if any corrections needed after apply.

jordan: ticketing notes for engineering follow-ups:
- add schema compatibility header to export job (p0)
- add manifest verification in playbook runner (p1)
- add end-to-end test to catch mapping changes (p1)

kai (analytics): also recommend an automated daily healthscore parity job that diffs current vs recalculated for a random sample and alerts on >5% drift.

anya: thanks team. sam please coordinate owner pings and apply canary once 2 owners ack. I'll sync with enablement to surface any customer-facing noise if owners flag anything. :pray:

sam (cs_ops): will post owner pings in 10m. ops-bot, please remind me in 24h to follow up if no ack.

ops-bot: reminder scheduled for sam (cs_ops) in 24 hours.

anya: retrospective action: add 'owner-ack' step to our playbook automation for bulk healthscore updates — require at least one explicit owner ack or a 24h auto-apply window with audit log.

jordan: noted. will add to the backlog and assign in sprint.

sam (cs_ops): posted CSV and pings now. will report back with ack status and canary apply results. :mag:
